spans.s: BP0309 उत्पत्तिः utpattiḥ originate or evolve
AF2379 उत्पाटयत इव utpāṭayata iva Uprooting pain.
BP0308 उत्पाटितः utpāṭitaḥ Pulled up by the roots , Eradicated.

SV0296 उत्पात utpāta Natural calamities – are of 3 types celestial, mundane and atmospheric weeping of idoles, appearance of magical cots etc. Mundane are earth quakes etc while falling of stars etc are atmospheric. These are also considered as cause of pestilence.
